verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS CRM, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about telemetry, analytics opt-out, or usage-tracking controls. The items cover APIs, SDKs, MCP, Zia and pricing, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
